inicio.textoPrincipal: "The collective is a group of photographers and image enthusiasts who come together to learn photography in a collaborative way. The curiosity of some and the experience of others propose a dynamic of exchange that gives rise to questions and answers, through which we provoke independent thought that translates into images with a creative, individual, intimate language. We provoke an inner conversation that gives us elements to portray external reality."

expoCafe.informacion: Expo Café is a photographic exhibition that explores coffee as a cultural, social, and aesthetic territory.

tips.tip1: If you have not yet taken the photos, set the camera to maximum resolution in order to rigorously work the image in the printing process.
tips.tip2: Study the proposed themes. Get involved with the concepts, visit the places, and perceive their atmosphere.
tips.tip3: Get inspired by looking at the work of other photographers and look for similar settings or images near your surroundings.
tips.tip4: Study what equipment you could use to take the imagined photo. Draw it, make a sketch. If you are not clear about the necessary equipment, ask in the Collective's WhatsApp.

curaduria.texto: The sponsors of the exhibition reserve the right to carry out a curation of the proposed images.

f7f918a4-d27c-4cab-b53d-8985125954d8.nombre: The whisper of coffee before dawn
f7f918a4-d27c-4cab-b53d-8985125954d8.descripcion_autor: Born in Colombia and living in Belgium, is a senior full-stack developer, entrepreneur. He also practices photography as a personal hobby.

3ad7fa9f-b303-4c03-8c5b-491c4f238ec0.descripcion_autor: Software Engineer, entrepreneur, innovator, and amateur photographer. After more than 20 years of experimenting with light, I continue to find inspiration in routine and magical moments.
3ad7fa9f-b303-4c03-8c5b-491c4f238ec0.descripcion_foto: This photograph was taken one evening in October 2014, during the first anniversary celebration of Café Bourbón in Bogotá. A couple of friends were roasting and serving some of the best coffee I had ever tasted. After setbacks and attempts, they are now called Café Tropicalia and have been selected in the last two years as one of the ten best coffee shops in the world.

273e9604-0554-4d16-8e17-4e68343033d2.descripcion_autor: Amateur photographer with more questions than answers
273e9604-0554-4d16-8e17-4e68343033d2.descripcion_foto: This was the first of many, many photos about the world of coffee. This facade stood as a portal to this world where the dark marble, the gold lettering, and the warm stonework evoke a sense of permanence in a fast-paced world.

6494055d-6264-4a18-b232-a6fd1b6764a8.descripcion_foto: Looking closely at the contrasting colors makes this crop one of the most beautiful.

3b0d387d-b407-4ade-921f-4daae67fb368.nombre: The taste of a good coffee
3b0d387d-b407-4ade-921f-4daae67fb368.descripcion_autor: Amateur photographer with a passion for bird and landscape photography.
3b0d387d-b407-4ade-921f-4daae67fb368.descripcion_foto: More than a beverage, coffee is a connection. Behind that exceptional flavor lies the tireless effort of coffee-growing families who pour their experience and heart into cultivation. It is that love that travels from the field to your table, becoming the perfect excuse to share

0748cbc2-15f0-49a7-94dd-c12f1724fadc.descripcion_autor: An avid traveler, adventurer, photographer and a lover of coffee.
0748cbc2-15f0-49a7-94dd-c12f1724fadc.descripcion_foto: This was taken in the shade of the jungle while on a short hike along a stream with close friends just outside of Pueblo Bello, Colombia in the mountains of the Caribbean coast.

75e34310-4dff-4ffb-80ae-f36a4a56730c.descripcion_autor: Santiago Sandoval Abril is a theatre student based in Bogotá. His work is built on a careful observation of everyday life. His gaze seeks light not only as a technical element, but as a means to reveal unique situations that emerge from the seemingly ordinary. Beyond framing and the isolated image, his photography is concerned with the present as an experience: moments that, when observed attentively, acquire an extraordinary quality. Each image proposes a pause, an invitation to recognize presence, time, and sensitivity within the everyday.

c194796e-e978-4941-b6cc-7704d0c553b0.descripcion_autor: A Colombian photographer who works at the intersection of graphic design and cultural management, with close ties to production, image management, and teaching in this field within dentistry. His exploratory photography presents his vision as he attempts to decipher the flow of life amidst the bustle of the city where he carries out much of his work, as well as in other places he visits with the same intention.
c194796e-e978-4941-b6cc-7704d0c553b0.descripcion_foto: A moment to breath. A sip of a good coffee to meditate

b7ea8cb-a5b8-4ab1-b915-ed1da8ad26b7.descripcion_foto: A cozy corner where coffee, sweetness, and warmth come together, a perfect moment to pause and enjoy.

d9493745-b9c7-4385-a6a5-4d428a15c171.descripcion_autor: Amateur photographer with more questions than answers.
d9493745-b9c7-4385-a6a5-4d428a15c171.descripcion_foto: An attempt to capture the work of the barista and pay homage to the skill and silent, rigorous alchemy behind the scenes that transforms a simple coffee bean into a perfect cup.

3736eeaf-c99d-4e95-87aa-96870b528b14.descripcion_autor: A self-taught photographer. With other members of the Pateperros group, he has conducted workshops, primarily on film photography. He has exhibited his documentary work in Colombia, Spain, Argentina, and Brazil. He comes from the old school of black and white photography and still shoots with film; he combines digital processes using vintage analog equipment and playfully demonstrates the fundamentals of photography.
3736eeaf-c99d-4e95-87aa-96870b528b14.descripcion_foto: As relevant as ever, this quote from Tzvetan Todorov formed the backdrop for a discussion at the Luvina Bookstore; a beautifully prepared cappuccino was the perfect excuse to capture the moment. We met there every Thursday to talk about everything except photography. It was 2008, and cell phones weren't yet so sophisticated; a rudimentary Sony Ericsson camera was enough to record the profound meaning of this quote.

d321215b-953a-4024-807d-cfc96c8a78b8.descripcion_autor: @Arttesano on social media, is a Bogotá-based leather artisan. He studied Physics, and his thesis, "Stroboscopic Photography in the Teaching of Physics,"opened his door to the world of photography as a pedagogical tool for constructing scientific knowledge. In his quest to understand human nature, he approaches photography from a social perspective.He considers photography a social document, a testimony. His style is candid and intimate. His camera is an instrument for preserving memory; his photos are a treasure chest of memories stacked in boxes and on hard drives. Currently, his interest lies in bird photography and his records aid in species identification, and his phone becomes the walking stick of his memory.

ca458e21-a91d-412c-b091-b3d87be43e1c.descripcion_autor: A self-taught photographer. With other members of the Pateperros group, he has conducted workshops, primarily on film photography. He has exhibited his documentary work in Colombia, Spain, Argentina, and Brazil. He comes from the old school of black and white photography and still shoots with film; he combines digital processes using vintage analog equipment and playfully demonstrates the fundamentals of photography.
ca458e21-a91d-412c-b091-b3d87be43e1c.descripcion_foto: What I was observing at that moment was ironic. A latte made with "lactose-free" milk; I inadvertently stirred the design the barista had drawn, like when the wind scatters a sand mandala, and there, magically, appeared the Milky Way.

5696a081-3de1-4543-b2ca-e84b0549130f.descripcion_autor: Photographer with a special interest in capturing images of nature and landscapes, their essence, color, and majesty.
5696a081-3de1-4543-b2ca-e84b0549130f.descripcion_foto: A reflexion in color of the transformation that a good coffee bean undergoes until it is ready to be enjoyed.

55687b93-31ed-4b9b-a9f9-423ccc66dcc6.descripcion_autor: A photography enthusiast born in Ipiales, Nariño, in 2005. In his photographs, he captures a bit of what he feels when he sees the situations that unfold around him in his life, trying to anchor key moments in images that will transport him back, for a moment, to that specific point in his journey.

501632ce-012f-40ea-b8b3-83bbda3aaea8.descripcion_autor: Colombian-Norwegian photographer and visual artist, explores memory, the body, and the tensions between nature, technology, and society. His practice lies at the intersection of artistic photography, installation, and visual research, with a perspective shaped by his migratory experience and a critical observation of contemporary systems of production, consumption, and representation. Born in Colombia and based in Norway for decades, Pérez develops a visual language that engages with hybrid cultural landscapes: Latin American memory, Nordic aesthetics, and the global conflicts of late modernity. His images and projects address themes such as identity in transit, political ecology, the human-animal relationship, and the impact of industry on the body and the land.
